description: This file defines the ArticlesController class for handling HTTP requests related to articles in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes endpoints for fetching articles, article feeds, article details, creating, editing, and deleting articles, utilizing MediatR for mediating commands and queries.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller class managing CRUD operations and retrieval of articles with authorization applied for modification endpoints.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a list of articles with optional filters like tag, author, favorited, limit, and offset.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a feed of articles for the authenticated user, with similar filters.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific article identified by its slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article, requires authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing article identified by its slug, requires authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article identified by its slug, requires authorization.
